about_the_game:
About This Game

Caught in the wild during a routine hunt, you’re surrounded by a spreading blood curse that devours the land and warps reality. To survive, you must step through unstable portals into unknown worlds filled with deadly creatures, harsh environments, and the growing grip of blood magic.

Enter the Portals

Each portal leads to new location. These rifts transporting you to dangerous and unpredictable places. Each location holds the resources you need—but also new threats twisted by the curse.

Portal Runes

Use ancient runes to shift portal destinations, gaining control at a cost. Make full use of each new location and gather all the resources you need to survive and upgrade your base and gear.

Blood Has a Price

Some altars offer power... but demand your life in return. Trade health for rare rewards—but choose wisely. In this world, survival means sacrifice.

Fight the Blood Curse

Face beasts corrupted by ancient magic—twisted, vicious, and unlike anything you’ve seen before. Armed with blades, bows, cannons, explosives, traps, and powerful spells, you’ll need to stay one step ahead of death.

Hunt. Craft. Build.

Cut down trees. Hunt corrupted wildlife. Build what you need to last another day—shelters, tools, weapons. Every decision matters. Every resource counts. And the further you go from the safety of the barrier, the harder it gets.

Features

  • Blood for Rewards: Altars drain your health in exchange for something truly special.

  • Portals: Travel to random, dangerous realms.

  • Rune-Controlled Portals: Shift portals with magic.

  • Survival Mechanics: Hunt, gather, and fight to survive.

  • Combat Options: Use melee weapons, firearms (bows, crossbows, cannons), bombs, traps, and magical attacks.

  • Crafting & Building: Create tools and shelters.

  • Magical Barrier: Protects you from blood magic.

  • Dynamic Environments: Handcrafted and procedurally generated locations.

  • Mythical Creatures: Face dangerous creatures warped by blood magic.

Minimum:

  • Processor: INTEL CORE I5-8400 or AMD RYZEN 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3GB or AMD Radeon RX 570 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD (Preferred)

short_description: Blood is the price of survival, and you are trapped forever. Explore kingdoms through ancient portals, battle twisted creatures, and craft the tools you need to survive in this first-person single-player survival adventure.
